_comment: TEMPLATE — edit after deploying Package A (Functions) to your own Zoho Catalyst project. apiBase is the base URL Catalyst assigns your deployed Advanced I/O functions (Console -> Functions -> [any function] shows the invoke URL; apiBase is that URL's origin + path prefix, without the function name). loginUrl is your project's Embedded Authentication hosted sign-in page (Console -> Authentication -> Login URL). Neither value can be predicted before you deploy — this file intentionally ships with placeholders, not guesses.
